purpose: Teach: 艦隊/傲慢/天体/ホームレス/天下り/君が代/樹木/爆撃

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、艦隊勤務隊員のメンタル健康を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren — we manage the mental health of fleet personnel through our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady eye contact. Measured pace, no rush. Competent but not cold—this is routine care explained with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者に傲慢な態度を取らないよう医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We ensure our medical team never treats patients with condescension.
lines.style: Slight lean forward. Firm conviction on 「傲慢」. Quiet but non-negotiable. This is a principle, not a procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 天体観測愛好家の睡眠障害を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does handle sleep disorders in astronomy enthusiasts, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft, genuinely curious tone. Not testing—asking because he's turned this over in his mind. Respectful deference to expertise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ホームレスの方々の医療支援を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes. Our medical team takes the lead on healthcare support for homeless individuals.
lines.style: Same steady composure as the first line. Factual, unflinching. No defensiveness—this is work that matters and it shows in her even voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療界の天下り問題を、貴院、課題視されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital seems to take seriously the issue of parachute hiring in medicine, Doctor.
lines.style: Careful phrasing—he's checking his own question as he asks it. Intelligent observation delivered without challenge. Slight questioning lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、式典で君が代斉唱時の救護を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes. Our medical team handles emergency care during the national anthem at ceremonies.
lines.style: Same unwavering pace. No inflection on the unusual nature of the statement. Professional responsibility is professional responsibility, no matter how specific.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 街路樹木の花粉症対策を、貴院、進めてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital seems to be making progress on pollen allergies from street trees, Doctor.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of effort. Softer than his testing questions—this feels more like genuine recognition. Still curious, but warmer.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、戦時爆撃被災者の心のケアを医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Yes. Our medical team continues to provide psychological care for war bombing survivors.
lines.style: No hesitation. The weight of this statement sits in her steady voice without heaviness. Professional, honoring, grounded in continuity.
